text: Tomatoes need regular irrigation to maintain good production. Drip irrigation is recommended because it reduces water consumption. Water stress can reduce fruit size and quality.
Olive trees are resistant to drought, but young trees require regular watering. Mature olive trees need less frequent irrigation.
Tomatoes can suffer from fungal diseases. Farmers should monitor leaves, avoid excessive humidity, and use appropriate agricultural treatments.
Fertilizer selection depends on soil quality and crop requirements. Balanced nutrients such as nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium help improve production.
Souss-Massa is one of Morocco's important agricultural regions. It is known for tomato production and greenhouse farming.
